SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as sales_net,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as returns_net,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product_old p ON f.product_key IN (
  SELECT product_key FROM dim_product 
  WHERE sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product_old WHERE category = 'Garden')
)
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period >= 7 
  AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

WITH garden_skus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product_old WHERE category = 'Garden'
),
sales_with_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.product_key,
    f.sale_date,
    f.net_amount,
    COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0) as refund_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE f.product_key IN (
    SELECT dp.product_key FROM dim_product dp 
    WHERE dp.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM garden_skus)
  )
)
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(s.net_amount) as sales_gross_net,
  SUM(s.refund_net) as returns_net,
  SUM(s.net_amount) - SUM(s.refund_net) as net_sales
FROM sales_with_returns s
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON s.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period >= 7 
  AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

WITH garden_skus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product_old WHERE category = 'Garden'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT g.sku) as garden_sku_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.product_key) as garden_product_key_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as sales_lines_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_amount
FROM garden_skus g
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON g.sku = dp.sku
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON dp.product_key = f.product_key
  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-10-28' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-04-27'

WITH garden_skus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product_old WHERE category = 'Garden'
),
garden_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_key FROM dim_product 
  WHERE sku IN (SELECT sku FROM garden_skus)
),
sales_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.net_amount,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE f.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM garden_products)
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period >= 7 
    AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
),
returns_by_sale AS (
  SELECT 
    sales_line_id,
    SUM(refund_net) as refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line
  GROUP BY sales_line_id
)
SELECT 
  s.fiscal_year,
  s.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(s.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) as net_sales
FROM sales_with_dates s
LEFT JOIN returns_by_sale r ON s.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period
ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
